name: craft-codebase
description: Snapshot-pinned, read-only structural repository analysis for AI hosts.

interface.shortDescription: Explicit, read-only codebase structure and impact analysis.
interface.longDescription: Build a checkpoint-pinned structural index only when explicitly requested, then query symbols, callers, and candidate impact without reading source bodies into context or granting write authority.
defaultPrompt: Activate read-only codebase analysis for the declared workspace, build a checkpoint-pinned index, then inspect the requested symbol or candidate impact.
